scientific_integrity: Analytical proof reconstructed; 76 reproducible numerical diagnostics; same-model review only, independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-distance one-dimensional Brownian absorption with independent Poisson instantaneous resetting and fixed critical-window parameter is proved.
No claim of quantitative uniform convergence, optimization, or independence from all unindexed literature.
Previously published finite-reset split probabilities and unrestricted-reset first-passage asymptotics are credited; only the coupled critical and conditional clock limits are assessed.
title: Gumbel budget crossover and a Gaussian exhaustion-clock edge in Brownian resetting
